title: Russian Drones Hit Kyiv Academy of Sciences and Dnipro Office Centre, Killing at Least 7
detail: Russian drones struck downtown Kyiv, destroying part of the National Academy of Sciences building near the German embassy and hitting apartment blocks, offices and data centres. A drone also hit an office centre in central Dnipro during working hours, killing 3 and wounding at least 12. At least 7 were killed and more than 50 wounded nationwide, per AP; Al Jazeera put the wounded above 80.
